turns.tutor:
Good choice. Questions with did come next, after one first step: finished actions.
Example: Yesterday I cook dinner becomes Yesterday I cooked dinner.
Rule: for a finished action, add -ed to a regular verb.
Right: Last weekend I cleaned my room. Wrong: Last weekend I clean my room.
Now you try. Write the past form: Yesterday she ___ (call) me.
